title: one-page-personal-exp-sprint-log
body:
Mini experiment tracker (one page) - quick personal sheet and scratchpad

Purpose: keep a compact, real-time log of micro-experiments for latency/cost tradeoffs during the sprint. Not formal — notes to self, rough numbers, quick TODOs.

Columns: id | date | model | variant | dataset | batch | quant | p50(ms) | p95(ms) | cost/token(usd) | success | notes | next
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
E1 | 2026-02-06 | llama-2-13b | base | conversations-small | 1 | fp16 | 42 | 120 | 0.00075 | partial | kv cache warmed, small mem spike at step 10 | try batch=2, monitor p95
E2 | 2026-02-07 | opt-6.7b | quant4 | webtext-10k | 2 | q4f16 | 28 | 95 | 0.00045 | yes | stable p95, lower cost but small quality diff on long completions | run eval set A for quality comparison
E3 | 2026-02-10 | redwood-v1 | quant8 | chat-2k | 1 | q8 | 18 | 55 | 0.00022 | yes | excellent latency; truncation artifacts at 4k seq | test longer seqs 6k+ and check for hallucination rate
E4 | 2026-02-12 | custom-7b | base | conversations-small | 4 | fp16 | 60 | 180 | 0.0011 | no | queuing observed when batch>2 on this infra node | split requests across nodes; add timeouts
E5 | 2026-02-20 | llama-2-13b | cached-prefix | docs-5k | 1 | fp16 | 30 | 85 | 0.0006 | yes | prefix cache gave 15% p95 reduction for repeated prompts | add to canary for 24h

Quick aggregates (rough):
- Median p95 across last 5 runs: ~110ms (heavy models biased higher)
- Best cost/token: redwood-v1 q8 ~0.00022 USD/token (useful for high-throughput endpoints)
- Most unstable: custom-7b on node-42 (outlier p95s)

Scratch calculations:
- If avg token/runtime = 30 tokens/sec for redwood-v1 -> cost/sec = 30 * 0.00022 = 0.0066 USD/sec (~0.4 USD/min)
- Estimate monthly (steady 5 qps sustained): cost_per_token * tokens_per_request * qps * seconds_in_month
  Example: 0.00022 * 80 * 5 * 2,592,000 = ~22,956 USD/month (back-of-envelope; double-check tokens/request)

Immediate action items / TODOs (personal):
- [ ] Run eval set A (100 prompts) on E2 vs E5 and collect Rouge/BLEU-ish proxies + human sample (deadline: 2026-03-05)
- [ ] Reproduce queue spike for E4 on a clean node; capture perf profile (gprof) and SLO traces (deadline: asap)
- [ ] Try batch=3 for redwood-v1 q8 to test throughput/cost sweet spot (note: watch p95)
- [ ] Make a 1-slide summary for weekly sync (metrics + recommended canary)

Notes to self / loose ideas:
- Consider mixing quant8 for inference heavy routes and keep fp16 for API calls flagged as high-quality (tiering)
- Would be useful to tag runs with git sha and infra id; quick hack: add "run_tags" column next time
- Link to perf dashboards: keep one ephemeral dashboard for the sprint to avoid polluting product dashboards

Recent mental checklist after experiments:
- Did I capture seed + prompt template? sometimes forget -> add minimal prompt hash column next run
- Are these runs comparable? dataset size and tokenization should be consistent.

Mini log of ephemeral commands I used (copy me later into a real script):
- python perf/run.py --model redwood-v1 --quant q8 --batch 1 --dataset chat-2k --out perf/e3.json
- curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d @prompt.json https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate?model=llama-2-13b

References and links I might need:
- jira: JIRA-APPL-834 (experiment infra flakiness)
- pr: github.com/redwood/pr/562 (logging changes)
- confluence: confluence/exp-note-219 (longer writeup, don't duplicate here)

End of mini-sheet. Keep this page terse; move stable results to shared drive / confluence when ready.
